alerts.headline: High Surf Advisory issued November 13 at 1:23AM PST until November 15 at 10:00AM PST by NWS San Diego CA
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Large breaking waves of 5 to 7 feet with sets to 8 to 9
feet at west facing beaches. High rip current risk.

* WHERE...San Diego County Coastal Areas and Orange County
Coastal Areas.

* WHEN...From 4 PM today to 10 AM PST Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Dangerous swimming and surfing conditions and
localized beach erosion and overflow.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Tides will be falling during this time, but
adjusted high tides will be near 7 feet which could combine with
the high surf to produce localized beach erosion and overflow
into parking lots and boardwalks. Surf begins to wane Sunday
afternoo
